dct_description_sm: To investigate the role of a nearby seabird colony of northern fulmars (Fulmarus glacialis) in the transfer of total mercury through guano to local terrestrial food webs at Cape Vera, Devon Island, Nunavut, Canada.  This project was conducted with the support of the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC), the Polar Continental Shelf Project (PCSP), and the Northern Scientific Training Program (NSTP).
dct_title_s: THg and Stable Isotope Food Web Data, Cape Vera, Devon Island, Nunavut, Canada
